title: Root multiplication block coordinates
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal with nonzero R=A/I, f in A[X] monic, and g,h in R[X] monic and coprime with f.map(mk I)=g*h. Use the power bases of the three monic quotients [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free]. There exist d: Fin deg f ≃ Fin deg g ⊕ Fin deg h and a unit U on this sum index over R such that U reindex_d(T.map(mk I)) U^-1 = blockdiag(Tg,Th), where T,Tg,Th are multiplication by the respective roots in these power bases.

source.place: Tag 09XI, proof of (3) implies (1), the decomposition of B/IB; matrix coordinate details via monic division, CRT and power bases (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09XI)

proof.text: Reduce the monic power-basis multiplication matrix coefficientwise. Monic division commutes with coefficient reduction by uniqueness of remainder, and monicity over the nonzero residue ring preserves degree.
Apply CRT to the comaximal principal ideals (g) and (h), whose intersection is (g*h), obtaining the algebra equivalence to the two polynomial quotients and carrying the root to the pair of roots.

Concatenate the two power bases; their dimensions sum to deg f by monicity. Reindex the reduced basis by an equivalence d. The coordinate matrix U of CRT is invertible, with inverse the coordinate matrix of the inverse equivalence.

Intertwine root multiplication by CRT and use the matrix-of-composition identity to obtain the root conjugation identity. Empty power bases handle either constant factor and the constant parent polynomial.

lean.statement: theorem adjoinRoot_crt_matrix_root_block {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [Nontrivial (A ⧸ I)] (f : A[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (g h : (A ⧸ I)[X]) (hg : g.Monic) (hh : h.Monic) (hcoprime : IsCoprime g h) (hfactor : f.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = g * h) : let b := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hf).basis let T := Algebra.leftMulMatrix b (AdjoinRoot.root f) let Tg := Algebra.leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hg).basis (AdjoinRoot.root g) let Th := Algebra.leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hh).basis (AdjoinRoot.root h) ∃ (d : Fin f.natDegree ≃ (Fin g.natDegree ⊕ Fin h.natDegree)) (U : (Matrix (Fin g.natDegree ⊕ Fin h.natDegree) (Fin g.natDegree ⊕ Fin h.natDegree) (A ⧸ I))ˣ), U.val * Matrix.reindex d d (T.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) * U⁻¹.val = Matrix.fromBlocks Tg 0 0 Th
